text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is not a review article. While it uses projected habitat area changes, these are not the result of a spatial LULC prediction model implemented by the authors; they are derived from external literature and expert projections. The paper lacks spatial modeling, quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC prediction, and mapped LULC projections. Its central research question is the valuation of an ecosystem service, not LULC prediction.)
